name: Threat From the Sea
summary: Tok'Kar sends you to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows. Katar hates the sea and takes pleasure in seeing fish men fall to those who serve the Horde. Now Katar asks how many you can slay and whether you can face their strongest kind.

sections.title: A Grudge Against the Sea
sections.body: In the Swamp of Sorrows, Katar asks you to kill marsh murlocs, marsh inkspewers and marsh flesheaters. Katar despises the sea and every creature from it. To Katar, the sea is a strong but blind, callous and brutal mistress. Slaying fish men by the hundreds would delight Katar, if that were possible. For now, watching them fall to those who serve the Horde brings some satisfaction.

sections.title: Katar's Verdict
sections.body: When you return, Katar says the sea may seem vast and relentless, yet its offspring now bear your bloody mark. The fish men know pain and must rebuild their ranks, which pleases Katar. Each time one is silenced, Katar will smile and invite you to slay more.

faq.q: Why does Katar want the murlocs destroyed?
faq.answer: Katar hates the sea and every creature from it, and would gladly see fish men slain by the hundreds. Watching them die at the hands of those who serve the Horde gives Katar some pleasure.

faq.q: Where does this hunt take place?
faq.answer: You hunt marsh murlocs, marsh inkspewers and marsh flesheaters in the Swamp of Sorrows.

aliases: who gives threat from the sea
faq.answer: Katar gives the hunt in the Swamp of Sorrows, after Tok'Kar sends you to speak with Katar.

aliases: threat from the sea previous quest
faq.answer: It follows the first Threat From the Sea, when Tok'Kar sent you to speak with Katar.
